text:
Maya: quick flag — compact rows in the workloads table are clipping the focus halo for icon-only actions (copy, rename, more). seems worse at the smallest density token. can someone take a look?
Rohan: saw that in staging. which browser and row height?
Maya: Chrome, 34px rows. tab to the copy icon and the halo is half-hidden at the bottom.
Sam: probable cause: icons were nudged with negative margins for visual alignment and the row uses overflow:hidden. that combo will clip outer outlines.
Priya: negative margins were a cheap fix. we could either: remove overflow hidden on tr, switch to padding alignment, or render focus as a contained box-shadow.
Rohan: +1 for box-shadow on the button. keeps row clipping behavior but preserves visible focus. example: `button.icon:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-400); }`
Maya: tiny UX note — in compact mode the 3px halo feels heavy. maybe 1.5-2px in compact only.
Sam: agree. token idea: map --focus-halo-size to density tokens (compact:2px, default:3px, spacious:4px).
Priya: accessibility: current aria-labels are too generic ("copy"). Screen reader reads "button copy" — not helpful. Should be contextual e.g., `aria-label="Copy <deployment-name> id"`.
Rohan: implement `aria-label={`Copy ${item.name} id`}` where item is row props. Also add an inline confirmation that is local to the row instead of global toast.
Maya: I like inline toast. It should be ephemeral and positioned absolutely inside the row so it doesn't affect layout. 
Sam: implementation caveat: use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` so screen readers announce it, and ensure it doesn't get focus.
Priya: keyboard order check as well — after adding spacing/halo we must verify tab order stays icon1 -> icon2 -> menu -> row-select.
DesignBot: created task DS-923: compact icon focus + contextual labels + inline confirmation.
Maya: plan: Sam will prototype the box-shadow + token mapping; Rohan will add aria-labels and inline toast; Priya will run a11y checks. Aim to land a small patch to dev by Thursday.
Sam: will push a prototype branch today, include before/after screenshots.
Rohan: will add descriptive labels and update copy in the copy handler to include the deployment name.
Priya: i'll test with VoiceOver and NVDA once branch is up.
Maya: thanks all — also small follow-up: consider tooltip direction (left/right) for icons near table edges to prevent overflow.
Sam: noted, will include tooltip alignment logic.
DesignBot: reminder: design sync Friday 11am.
